description: This file defines a React component for rendering a data table with features like sorting, filtering, column customization, and server-side pagination. It includes utility functions for sanitizing header IDs, calculating cell widths and offsets, and managing table state and interactions.

methods.name: getSortTypeByDataType
methods.description: Determines the sort type based on data type (datetime, alphanumeric, or basic).

methods.name: sanitizeHeaderId
methods.description: Sanitizes a column identifier for use in HTML id attributes and CSS selectors by replacing special characters with safe strings.

methods.name: cellWidth
methods.description: Calculates the width percentage for a cell in a horizontal bar chart based on its value and range.

methods.name: cellOffset
methods.description: Calculates the left offset percentage for a cell in a horizontal bar chart.

methods.name: cellBackground
methods.description: Determines the background color for a cell in a horizontal bar chart based on its value and theme.

methods.name: SortIcon
methods.description: Renders a sort icon indicating the sort state of a column.

methods.name: SearchInput
methods.description: Component for rendering a search input box for filtering table data.

methods.name: SelectPageSize
methods.description: Component for selecting the number of entries displayed per page.

methods.name: getNoResultsMessage
methods.description: Returns a localized message when no records match the filter.
